evidence.title: Flexential reports a Hillsboro facility currently under construction
evidence.excerpt: The dated issuer release identifies a current 36 MW Portland-Hillsboro build, separately from another planned Hillsboro facility. Historical and current owner identity records reconcile the current build to Hillsboro 5.

metadata.identity_inference: Explicitly analyst reconciliation, not an issuer H5 renaming statement: September 2025 separates four operating facilities and named H5 358000 sq ft/36 MW under construction; May 2026 binds named H5 to 4975 NE Starr and distinguishes operating H3 plus future H6; July ESG context retains H5 awaiting completion; August separates current 36 MW and another planned 36 MW in Hillsboro. Capacity alone is insufficient.
metadata.phase_scope: Generic current construction on the H5 campus. Do not infer whole-building nonoperation, exact remaining hall, active-work footprint or capacity delivered/undelivered.
metadata.contrary_evidence: May 28 says H4 and H5 both deliver GPU/CPU-ready environments. Undated owner H5 page/brochure say the design is built to support high-density requirements. These may reflect marketed or partial service and are not dismissed; neither provides a dated whole-project completion. The later explicit current-work statement supports only generic current construction.
metadata.explicit_exclusions: H3/H4 existing operations, future H6 at Aloclek, planned additional Hillsboro development, and other cities' projects are not selected construction rows.
metadata.rights_scope: Independently restated factual projection only. Source prose, source HTML, images and logos remain temporary; issuer-distributed text is not a reporter construction paraphrase.
